video_title: Is Tonight A MUST-WIN For Spurs? + Will Wemby Bounce Back?

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama needs to show more aggression on the offensive end
quotes.excerpt: He has to be more aggressive. He cannot settle for threes when he has that size.
quotes.quote: He has to be more aggressive. He cannot settle for threes when he has that size. When you are seven-foot-four, you should be living in the paint, putting pressure on the rim, and forcing the defense to collapse. Right now, he is drifting too much to the perimeter, and that is not helping the Spurs establish any kind of rhythm.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: The Spurs lack the veteran leadership to stabilize Victor Wembanyama
quotes.excerpt: They are missing that veteran voice in the locker room to keep him grounded.
quotes.quote: They are missing that veteran voice in the locker room to keep him grounded. When you have a talent like Victor Wembanyama, you need guys who have been through the wars, guys who can tell him when to slow down and when to take over. Without that, he is just out there trying to figure it all out on his own, and that is a recipe for inconsistency.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: Gregg Popovich is still the right coach for the Spurs rebuild
quotes.excerpt: You do not question Gregg Popovich when he is building something from the ground up.
quotes.quote: You do not question Gregg Popovich when he is building something from the ground up. People want to see immediate results, but this is a long-term project. He is teaching these young guys how to play the right way, and that takes time. You have to trust the process, even when the losses are piling up.

quotes.speaker: Michelle Beadle
quotes.summary_phrase: The pressure on the Spurs to win tonight is overblown
quotes.excerpt: Is it really a must-win, or are we just looking for a narrative?

text_blocks.speaker: Michelle Beadle
text_blocks.text: Is it really a must-win, or are we just looking for a narrative? It is early in the season, and everyone is acting like the sky is falling.

text_blocks.speaker: Chandler Parsons
text_blocks.text: It is not a must-win for the playoffs, but it is a must-win for their confidence. They need to feel what it is like to close out a game.
